name: Brenda McFarden
source:
The mature-adult-aged lead researcher, who organized genetical modification on Konohana Lucia, and also the lead researcher of the Guardian secret society. The former second-in-command of the old Next Generation Humanity Project.

[spoiler]She is the main antagonist of Lucia's route.[/spoiler]
